implementation: VoiceHub-owned PyTorch graph; no upstream runtime import
limitations: The published 12 Hz Mimi-derived speech encoder, semantic/acoustic residual quantizers, and decoder are native and checkpoint-exact. Legacy VoiceHub decoder-only exports remain supported but cannot encode a new ICL reference.
Native file and URL reference decoding accepts uncompressed PCM WAVE; callers can pass predecoded tensors for other audio containers.
